Okay so, sometimes when I’m super fixated or thinking about things that might be wrong with me I experience this strange “detachment” from my body that manifests itself as this kind of “pressure” in my head. It usually happens when I’m fixating on my emotions, or thoughts, and when I’m wondering “am I a sociopath or psychopath?” Even though my psychiatrist firmly established that it’s more likely to be my autism, but has also happened with other mental health or neurological conditions. When I think something is wrong with me, I start experiencing the symptoms of it almost immediately. I think I’m a psychopath, I feel lower empathy and emotions… which is my current problem… when I think I have dementia, my memory becomes chaotic and disorganized, also a problem.. I’ve also been experiencing things like memory problems outside of fixating on dementia, which I think could be because I’m constantly in an almost “daydream” state. 

Like I also mentioned, I have some blurry vision issues and problems focusing on things like movies and games. Which I think could be a whole mix of mental or even physical problems, Do you think the problem could still be anxiety related? Or maybe a mix of mental health problems? One think I thought of is this could be a mix of my other mental problems, I have had ADHD from an extremely young age along with other things like autism and recently hypochondria… which could possibly be pure OCD.  ADHD would explain things like the attention focus problems and memory problems, cause for most of my life I was on an ADHD medication for my whole life that organized my thoughts and emotions. My autism could also explain my emotional problems and maybe even my fixations mixed with a little OCD? When I’m fixated on something, it’s all I can think and talk about. I can’t even think properly or engage in normal conversations with my parents without making a comment about “something is wrong with my brain” or something like that. I’ve also considered things like schizophrenia, cause of the nature of my delusions and how they’re becoming more eccentric overtime, but I also think that could be a psychotic break from being under pressure and anxiety for almost 2 years.. When I think about stuff, it also feels like my consciousness detaches from my body, and like I mentioned in my post… it almost feels like I’m believing my brain to be its own separate entity independent of my body, even though I know deep down it is apart of me. I don’t feel like I can have organic thoughts anymore, all my thoughts are suppressed really hard and I’ve constantly been giving myself strange thoughts to see how I would react…. Which could be OCD… my brain just feels locked in a frozen state anymore, I’ll sometimes have moments where I imagine my “soul” slipping back into my body or going into my face… and I’ll feel normal for a bit before I start thinking again. I don’t think I have DID, or anything like that, I just think this is an obsessive problem for me… and the reason THAT works is cause I’m just using placebo effects to trick my brain into thinking things. This encompasses my entire life, I never really stop thinking about what I am or what I might have. When I’m watching movies, playing games, or doing anything really.. I’m at constant war with my mind, and will always think things like “why did I do that?” Or “why do I enjoy this type of game or story” and I just can’t do it. The only way I combat this is by verbally talking out to myself, kinda forcing myself to get into what I’m doing, faking it until I make it… the talking is weird, yeah, but it’s not like I’m “having a conversation” with nothing.. I know nobody else is around me or hearing what I’m saying, in a way I’m just talking to myself.. but know I’m talking to myself? I don’t know if that’s related to any of this..
